description: This file defines the Subscription model class for Opencart's admin sale module, handling CRUD operations and retrieval of subscription data, histories, logs, and related entities.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Model class for managing sale subscriptions, including CRUD, history, logs, and related operations.

methods.name: deleteSubscription
methods.description: Deletes a subscription record and related products, histories, and logs.

methods.name: editRemaining
methods.description: Updates the remaining quantity for a subscription.

methods.name: editDateNext
methods.description: Updates the next date for a subscription.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionByCustomerPaymentId
methods.description: Deletes a subscription based on the customer payment ID.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves a subscription record by its ID, decoding JSON fields for payment and shipping methods.

methods.name: getSubscriptionByOrderProductId
methods.description: Retrieves a subscription record associated with a specific order product.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Fetches a list of subscriptions based on various filter criteria, with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptions
methods.description: Returns the count of subscription records matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionsByStoreId
methods.description: Counts subscriptions associated with a specific store.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionsBySubscriptionStatusId
methods.description: Counts subscriptions with a specific status.

methods.name: deleteProducts
methods.description: Deletes subscription products linked to a subscription.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves products linked to a subscription.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves options for a given subscription and product.

methods.name: deleteOptions
methods.description: Deletes options linked to a subscription.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a history entry for a subscription and updates its status.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Removes all history entries for a subscription.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves histories for a subscription with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Counts total history entries for a subscription.

methods.name: getTotalHistoriesBySubscriptionStatusId
methods.description: Counts history entries filtered by subscription status.

methods.name: deleteLogs
methods.description: Deletes log entries for a subscription.

methods.name: getLogs
methods.description: Retrieves log entries for a subscription with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalLogs
methods.description: Counts total log entries for a subscription.
